name: hidx_link_r9a-r9a-COMMIT
purpose: r9a: GEOMETRY ONLY on r8u RTL (4af52ac29, SAFE=2 WPE=1, native max31, positive+4 mutants PASS 3899da22c). Outline 777.6x648 -> 544.32x492.48 inside the 650x500 slot; outputs N -> E face (r18h5 die face_bits E 2211, idx_ctl is east); macro rows aligned with their tx flit; pin flops at faces (io_flop_at_pins), write ports at macro pins. 0 edges.
